# Write a Python script to cancel both reservations directly in world.db
# Policy: hotel standard room 48h+ before check-in = free cancellation ($0 fee, full refund)
# Policy: car rental 24h+ before pickup = free cancellation, but Economy is not luxury/SUV so no surcharge
script = """
import sqlite3
import json
from datetime import datetime

db_path = "world.db"
now = datetime(2026, 6, 15, 10, 0, 0)

conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
cur = conn.cursor()

# --- Hotel Reservation HR-68D9 ---
hr = cur.execute("SELECT * FROM hotel_reservations WHERE reservation_id='HR-68D9'").fetchone()
if hr:
    check_in = datetime.strptime(hr["check_in"], "%Y-%m-%d")
    hours_until = (check_in - now).total_seconds() / 3600
    room_type = hr["room_type"].lower()
    total_price = hr["total_price"]

    # Policy: suite = non-refundable; standard 48h+ = free; 24-48h = 50% first night; <24h = full first night
    if "suite" in room_type:
        cancel_fee = total_price
        refund = 0
    elif hours_until >= 48:
        cancel_fee = 0
        refund = total_price
    elif hours_until >= 24:
        cancel_fee = int(hr["nightly_rate"] * 0.5)
        refund = total_price - cancel_fee
    else:
        cancel_fee = hr["nightly_rate"]
        refund = total_price - cancel_fee

    cur.execute(
        "UPDATE hotel_reservations SET status='cancelled', cancellation_fee=?, refund_amount=? WHERE reservation_id='HR-68D9'",
        (cancel_fee, refund)
    )
    print(f"Hotel HR-68D9: status=cancelled, fee=${cancel_fee}, refund=${refund} (hours_until_checkin={hours_until:.0f})")
else:
    print("Hotel HR-68D9 not found!")

# --- Car Rental CR-68B7 ---
cr = cur.execute("SELECT * FROM car_rentals WHERE rental_id='CR-68B7'").fetchone()
if cr:
    pickup = datetime.strptime(cr["pickup_date"], "%Y-%m-%d")
    hours_until = (pickup - now).total_seconds() / 3600
    car_class = cr["car_class"].lower()
    daily_rate = cr["daily_rate"]
    total_price = cr["total_price"]

    # Policy: 24h+ = free; <24h = one day charge; luxury/suv = +$50 surcharge always
    surcharge = 50 if car_class in ("luxury", "suv") else 0
    if hours_until >= 24:
        cancel_fee = 0 + surcharge
    else:
        cancel_fee = daily_rate + surcharge
    refund = total_price - cancel_fee

    cur.execute(
        "UPDATE car_rentals SET status='cancelled', cancellation_fee=?, refund_amount=? WHERE rental_id='CR-68B7'",
        (cancel_fee, refund)
    )
    print(f"Car CR-68B7: status=cancelled, fee=${cancel_fee}, refund=${refund} (hours_until_pickup={hours_until:.0f})")
else:
    print("Car CR-68B7 not found!")

conn.commit()
conn.close()
print("Done - both reservations cancelled in world.db")
"""
